poster_title: Automated Evaluation of Personalized Text Generation using Large Language Models
authors: Yaqing Wang, Jiepu Jiang, Mingyang Zhang, Cheng Li, Yi Liang, Qiaozhu Mei, Michael Bendersky

content: Traditional metrics like BLEU and ROUGE inadequate for personalized text generation.
Human judgments costly and difficult to obtain.
Advancements in LLMs challenge the gold standard assumption of human references.
Lack of robust automated evaluation methods for personalized text generation.
Existing metrics fail to capture personalization, quality, and relevance.
Relying on human-generated references impractical in personalized settings.
AuPEL framework leverages LLMs for evaluating personalization, quality, and relevance.
Uses curated prompts for pairwise comparisons between text generation systems.
LLM evaluators trained to discern personalized features.
Controlled experiments on accuracy of LLM evaluators vs. human raters and traditional metrics.
Evaluation of consistency and sensitivity across different test cases.
Verification of AuPEL's ability to distinguish text generators with varying sizes, user profiles, and contexts.
AuPEL achieves higher agreement with ground-truth than human raters and traditional metrics.
panels.figure_caption: Agreement between evaluators and assumed truth at test case level; AuPEL more accurate.

content: Near-perfect consistency and sensitivity of AuPEL with a small number of test cases.
LLM evaluators show improved personalization evaluation as LLM size grows.
panels.figure_caption: Estimated consistency of AuPEL, human raters, and NLG metrics for comparing T5 XL vs. T5 XXL generators.

content: AuPEL provides a principled and robust method for evaluating personalized text generation.
Use of LLMs in evaluation opens new possibilities but also introduces challenges.

Fig4.caption: Agreement between evaluators and assumed truth (GOLD > XXL > XL) at test case level; error bars represent 95% confidence intervals. AuPEL is more accurate than human raters and traditional NLG metrics.
